body: Founder reported requeuing into Battlegrounds after returning to Town worked twice then failed every time, and confirmed killing+relaunching the client fixed it -- a strong signal it was client state, not the server. Traced it precisely: get_player_login_ticket mints a connect ticket once at initial login; net_connect() reused that same ticket for every reconnect for the rest of the session. IDUNA's RedgardenTicketTTL is a hardcoded 5 minutes, and arena_server silently drops PACKET_CONNECT for an expired ticket with no rejection sent back -- looks identical to 'the human never joined the lobby,' which is what an earlier bot-pool/matchmaker investigation this same session (real, but a red herring for this specific bug) had found: matches sitting stuck at 19/20 connected. Added refresh_self_ticket(), minting a fresh ticket from the stored login JWT before every connect instead of reusing the first one. This was never a REDGARDEN-side issue -- fixed entirely client-side in GoblinFoxDragon's battlegrounds_gui.
title: Real fix: requeue failures were a stale 5-minute connect ticket, not the bot pool
